fusions.name: Running Stitch
fusions.desc: Throws a threaded needle that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Rally to the Colours
fusions.desc: Slams a shod banner pole down, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Wire-Thread Lining
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it, and your armour rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Ring by Ring
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
